overlaps cybersecurity but lacks media brands and consumer offerings."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Research subscriptions, advisory and conferences for executives and vendors, not ad-supported consumer publishing or testing software."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Owns ad- and affiliate-driven consumer media brands in lifestyle and health, selling audiences to advertisers, matching Ziff Davis's core model."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Publishes news and information brands earning subscriptions and advertising from readers and advertisers, close to Ziff Davis's media revenue model."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Advertising agency network paid by client fees and commissions, a service business rather than owning and monetizing media brands."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise application development, data and infrastructure software sold to IT teams, unrelated to Ziff Davis's consumer media brands."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"IP communications and session border hardware and software for carriers, a telecom infrastructure business rather than media or security software."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Content recommendation and native ad-buying platform for publishers and advertisers, an ad-tech business rather than owned consumer brands."},{"label":"C13","good":true,"reason":"Owns sports, lifestyle and finance media brands earning advertising, affiliate commissions and subscriptions from readers and brands, like Ziff Davis's media portfolio."},{"label":"C14","good":false,"reason":"Programmatic ad buying software and managed campaigns for advertisers and agencies, an ad-tech business without owned media brands."}]}
